text:
Maya: Kicking off co-marketing with NebulaCloud — focusing on a joint launch: product demo + quick benchmark post + evergreen how-to blog. Goal: 500 signups, 120 MQLs in 6 weeks.
Tom: Love it. timeline? what's the webinar date window?
Maya: Proposed webinar week of May 16 (two options: Tue 16 or Thu 18). Want partner to pick by EOD Fri.
Ana: I can lock partner availability. Nebula prefers Thu 18.
Raj: Thu works for sales. We should route inbounds to SDR queue "Nebula-Launch" then tag by ARR band.
Elena: I'll draft the blog + benchmark narrative. Need benchmark data from eng-ml: latency/cost numbers comparing native Nebula infra vs Redwood routing.
Tom: For the landing page CTA: single opt-in form + hidden field source=nebula. Post-webinar nurture: 3-email sequence w/ benchmark highlights + invite to trial.
Maya: Quick routing rules: 1) Webinar registrants -> Nebula-Launch queue. 2) If company size > 1k employees or ARR > $1M -> SalesAlert. 3) Otherwise -> SDR nurture.
Raj: Can we use Zapier integration to auto-tag and create Salesforce lead? Ana?
Ana: Yes — we'll use LeadsBot to push to SF with mapping:  {"form_source":"nebula","utm_campaign":"nebula_launch"}. I'll paste mapping in #partner-ops.
LeadsBot: test trigger worked (payload sample):
```
{
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "company": "Acme",
  "employees": 250,
  "utm_campaign": "nebula_launch"
}
```
Maya: Elena, publish draft for review by Mon COB. Tom, prep webinar page copy + registration link. Ana, confirm SF field names and webhook URL. Raj, SDR playbook bullets?
Elena: Draft outline uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X_example (section: benchmark highlights, demo TL;DR, CTA).
Tom: Draft registration link (staging): https://redwood.ai/nebula-launch-staging — share to partners after they sign MSA.
Ana: Confirmed SF fields: Lead.Source__c, Campaign__c, Company_Size__c. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/partners/leads. I'll share creds in 1:1.
Raj: SDR playbook bullets: 1) Lead intro script, 2) benchmark one-pager, 3) 7-day cadence, 4) demo booking slot link. I'll drop the one-pager here by Tue.
Maya: Action items recap: Maya -> confirm webinar date with Nebula (Thu 18). Elena -> draft blog+benchmark by Mon. Tom -> registration page + email templates by Tue. Ana -> verify SF mapping + Zap by Tue. Raj -> SDR one-pager by Tue.
Tom: also: can we get a small paid social budget from growth? $2k to amplify registration to NB target accounts. cc @growth.
Maya: noted. I'll request budget. :raised_hands:
Elena: one question — benchmark visual: do we use PNGs or embed interactive figs? PNGs fastest.
Maya: go PNG for launch, interactive in blog follow-up.
Ana: Partner asked about co-branded PR. Need a 1-paragraph joint statement for legal. Elena can draft?
Elena: yes, will add a short quote from Redwood + Nebula.
Maya: Great. We'll reconvene Thu morning for final run-through. Thanks everyone :rocket:
